name: 13-prismray
prompt: Correct this sprite sheet layout for prismray. It accidentally has SEVEN columns; the output MUST have EXACTLY EIGHT COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, 32 separate poses total. Preserve the original spirit design, palette, detailed pixel art, and orientations. Use flat solid #FF00FF background, not checkerboard. Equal rectangular cells. Row 1 south facing, row 2 east/right facing, row 3 north/back facing, row 4 west/left facing. EVERY ROW has these EIGHT separate distinct poses in order: 1 idle, 2 walk left foot, 3 walk right foot, 4 charging/preparing attack WITHOUT a projectile, 5 releasing attack, 6 recoiling from being hit, 7 falling sideways, 8 lying peacefully fainted. Add the missing preparatory WINDUP pose as column FOUR so attack shifts to column FIVE and hit to SIX. Do not omit any column. All eight sprites must fit in the row. Same body scale throughout, generous magenta gutters between each spirit, no clipped parts. Full sheet fills image. No text, numbers, borders or labels. Original game production sprite asset.
